definitions.explanation: Indicates doing something together with someone or something. More formal than {一緒|いっしょ}に.
Indicates that something applies to both parties or items mentioned.

definitions.gloss: as, at the same time as
definitions.explanation: Used in the pattern 〜と{共|とも}に to mean 'as ~ happens' or 'along with ~'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}に⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I value the time I spend with my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦|くる}しみ→苦しみ：14120_kurushimi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{共|とも}に⟦{分|わ}かち{合|あ}う→分かち合う：18203_wakachiau⟧。
examples.english: We share both hardships and joys together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}に⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: It changes along with the times.
examples.notes: 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}に = along with ~, as ~ changes

examples.japanese: ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}に⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Moving toward our goal together with our companions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}に⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I set out on a journey together with a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧、{共|とも}に⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Both quality and quantity are important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧{共|とも}に⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is an event where both parents and children can participate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}に⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: My physical strength has declined with age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れ→訪れ：14267_otozure⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}に⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}き→咲く：08150_saku⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Flowers started blooming with the arrival of spring.

notes:
USAGE: {共|とも}に is more formal and literary than ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒に：25645_isshoni⟧. It's commonly used in written Japanese and formal speech.

PATTERNS:
・〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}に (together with ~)
・A⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧B⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{共|とも}に (both A and B)
・〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}に (as ~, along with ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{共|とも}に⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧ (to live together)
・{共|とも}に⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work together)
・{共|とも}に⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ (to learn together)
・⟦{苦楽|くらく}→苦楽：05566_kuraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{共|とも}に⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to share joys and sorrows)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒に：25645_isshoni⟧ - together (casual)
・⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧ - taking along
・⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - at the same time as
